# Token Range

> iOS app showing live rate limits for AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex,
> Cursor) in the app, on Home Screen widgets, and on the Lock Screen.
> Credentials stay in the device Keychain and are sent only to the provider
> over HTTPS. There is no Token Range server, no analytics, and no account.

Key facts:
- Platform: iOS 17 or later (iPhone).
- Supported tools at launch: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor. More planned.
- Pricing: one connected tool free forever; Lifetime Pro is a one-time
  USD 9.99 purchase (all providers, widgets, and 16 themes). No subscription.
- Privacy: on-device only. Keychain-stored credentials, HTTPS to providers,
  no first-party server, no tracking.
- Shows: session windows, weekly caps, percent remaining, reset countdowns,
  pace alerts before a limit runs out.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tokenrange.app/): product overview, live-limit demo, FAQ.
